svg.aria-label: pyrox-gp on the GeoStack role ladder: conditioning, the evidence factors, the variational objectives and the samplers as algorithms; the kernels, GP priors, likelihoods, guides, posteriors and pathwise samplers as models; the inference strategies and the CG solver as strategies; the predict and density methods and the latent-factor functions as primitives; the inducing features as structure. Beside the ladder, the setup functions and gaussx's solver strategies.
